title: Lava Dogs Off Leash at ITX
description: Marines and Sailors with 1st Battalion, 3rd Marine Regiment, conduct platoon attack drills for Integrated Training Exercise (ITX) aboard Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center Twentynine Palms, Calif., July 24. ITX focuses on the tactical application of combined-arms maneuver warfare and is a platform for demonstrating warfighting capability from all elements of the Marine Air Ground Task Force. Also available in high definition.
